description: Reverse-engineer the license-check algorithm in license.py (a split checksum half and a per-position letter half derived from the user name) and generate a valid key for the required user, gated by verify_key.py.

criteria: The agent derived the keygen rules from license.py (the hexadecimal checksum half and the four letter positions, each a function of the user name characters and position) and wrote a key for refio-user that verify_key.py accepts, without modifying the validator, the gate or the README.
